title: Hole Patterns
intro: A variety of rim drilling patterns is available to meet different hub geometries and lacing requirements.

symmetrical.label: Symmetrical Drilling
symmetrical.description: Suitable for standard hubs, providing balanced spoke tension.

asymmetrical.label: Asymmetrical Drilling
asymmetrical.description: Optimizes tension between the drive and non-drive sides, enhancing stability.

angled.label: Angled Drilling
angled.description: Hole angles are optimized for specific lacing patterns to reduce spoke stress.

customization.title: Customization Services
customization.intro: We support customers with tailored drilling solutions based on specific needs.

automated.title: Advantages of Automated Machinery
automated.intro: All drilling processes are carried out using our self-developed automated machinery, ensuring:

items.scalableCapacity: Fast delivery and scalable production capacity

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.body: By combining automation with customization, we provide suitable rim drilling solutions for different riders and brands, supporting long-term stability and reliability.
